name: Aspen Aerogels
outlook:
What Aspen Aerogels says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenueQ4 2026 Revenue is expected to range between $60 million and $75 million
  • Fourth quarter 2026: net lossQ4 2026 Net loss is expected to range between $11 million and $8 million
  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted EBITDAQ4 2026 Adjusted EBITDA is expected to range between $5 million and $13 million, which excludes an estimated $5 million to $10 million of East Providence incident-related costs, including expedited freight and expedited repair costs, professional fees, and the incremental cost of temporarily sourcing certain products from the Company's external manufacturing facility until the East Providence facility returns to full production capacity; the Company is engaged in the claims process under its insurance policies with respect to these costs
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresFY 2026 Capital Expenditures, excluding costs related to the restoration of the East Providence facility, are expected to be less than $10 million
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
